channel.title: cs.CL updates on arXiv.org
channel.description: cs.CL updates on the arXiv.org e-print archive.

item.title: A Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Context Reasoning in Large Language Models
item.description: arXiv:2511.00104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a benchmark for the evaluation of large language models on long-context reasoning. The benchmark contains 5,000 questions and we evaluate 20 language models, finding that accuracy degrades with context length.
item.dc:creator: Sara Okafor, Jörg Müller

item.title: LLM-as-a-Judge Is Biased Toward Verbose Answers
item.description: arXiv:2511.00105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as judges for model evaluation. We show that LLM judges systematically prefer longer answers and propose a length-controlled evaluation protocol.
item.dc:creator: Tom Brown, Ana Lima

item.title: Morphological Tagging for Low-Resource Bantu Languages
item.description: arXiv:2511.00108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We release annotated corpora and morphological taggers for six low-resource Bantu languages.
item.dc:creator: Kwame Mensah

item.title: Quantum-Inspired Word Embeddings
item.description: arXiv:2511.00111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose word embeddings inspired by density matrices from quantum mechanics.
item.dc:creator: Elena Rossi
